summary: Background discussion for the Telnet proposal in RFC 137. It gives views from committee members about the arguments behind the design, to help implementers interpret and evaluate it. The authors say these are not the committee's agreed position.

eli5.summary: A group wrote rules for a game, and this is a side note explaining why they chose them. It is only some members' thoughts.
